note: Where things are on the picture, measured from the game frame in images/frame.png. If the frame is redrawn with anything moved, change the numbers here to match; nothing in the Java needs to know. Rectangles are left, top, width, height, in game pixels. 'view' is the hole the world shows through; the frame is drawn over the world, so its rounded corners cover the corners of this. 'widgets' is the hole above the tabs, kept for a map button, gauges, and the like. 'chat' is the parchment, which the chat box and talk are both written straight onto. 'slots', 'top_tabs', and 'bottom_tabs' are the top left of the first inventory slot and of the first tab in each row; slots and tabs are 16 pixels square and 'pitch' apart, left edge to left edge, four to a row.
